_comment: $ per million tokens, verified against Anthropic's published pricing on 2026-08-16. Each model is an array of chronological rate periods; the LAST entry must have no "until" (src/types.ts enforces this at load) — that's the standing rate an introductory one rolls over to. Cache reads/writes are derived from `input` (0.1x / 1.25x) in src/pricing.ts, not listed separately here. OpenAI models are intentionally absent: PLAN.md's own table has no verified OpenAI rate to put here, and a guessed number in a cost ledger is worse than an honest gap — add one, from OpenAI's published pricing, when portfolio's OpenAiRunner migrates in Phase 2 (see PLAN.md's build order, step 4).
